valuation.method: Forward EPS x justified P/E. FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), in USD on the NYSE common share (1 share = 1 listing, no ADR ratio, no FX conversion). Earnings base: FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $7.65-$7.75 on 2026-10-20 (midpoint $7.70), which includes a $0.25 one-time IEEPA recovery in Q3, so underlying FY2026 is about $7.45. RTX said on 2026-11-10 (preliminary, ahead of formal guidance in January 2027) that it expects 2027 sales, earnings and free cash flow growth with margin expansion in all three segments. Third-party FY2027 EPS snapshots (undated aggregators) range about $7.53-$7.85 and were used only as a cross-check. Shares: 1,349.4m outstanding (aggregate row) against 1,368.1m diluted in the Q3 release; the cap of $262.6-273.4bn is above the $20bn threshold. Close $198.58 equals 25.5x base FY2027 EPS of $7.80 and 25.8x FY2026 guidance midpoint.

bear.driver: The IEEPA-type recovery and engine-related commercial aftermarket gains do not repeat, and GTF engine issues or defense program timing hold FY2027 EPS below the underlying FY2026 run-rate, while the market de-rates the stock to a 22x prime-defense-and-aerospace multiple.

base.driver: FY2027 EPS of $7.80 (about 5% above underlying FY2026 and in line with the company's preliminary 2027 growth statement) with backlog of $340bn supporting the multiple at 26x, close to today's FY2027 multiple.

bull.driver: Commercial aerospace aftermarket and defense backlog conversion lift FY2027 EPS about 11% above underlying FY2026 to $8.30, and the multiple re-rates to 29x, near the consensus target level.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $7.80 the close of $198.58 implies 25.5x. The named-analyst targets (mean of the eight Oct 21-28 targets is about $237) imply about 30x base EPS, or EPS of about $9.10 at 26x, so the analyst gap of roughly 17% is an EPS-or-multiple difference; their assumptions are not sourced.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E on base EPS moves the base target by $7.80 (3.9 pp of the close). A $0.50 change in FY2027 EPS moves it by $13.00 at 26x (6.5 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: FY2027 adjusted EPS guidance in January 2027 against the $7.80 base, and whether the Q4 2026 adjusted EPS run-rate excludes the $0.25 IEEPA recovery; the base case needs about $1.95 adjusted EPS per quarter across FY2027.
valuation.next_disclosure: Formal FY2027 guidance on the Q4 2026 results call; the aggregator date of Tuesday, Jan 26, 2027 before market open is unconfirmed and should be checked against RTX's investor relations calendar.

analyst_notes: Eight named analysts with dated calls from Oct 21 to Nov 10, 2026 are in the sample; all targets are sourced from StockAnalysis and their 12-month horizon is not documented in the source, so horizon is null and no call enters the weighted target. Since the Q3 release on 2026-10-20 the named revisions are UBS raised $209 to $212 (Hold), and the rest are Buy reiterations between $235 and $245; the targets average about $237 against the $202.80 base. Firm-only calls from MarketBeat (TD Cowen cut $240 to $225 on Oct 9, Bernstein cut $223 to $214 on Oct 15, Goldman $195 to $206 on Jul 27, DA Davidson $192 to $219 on Jul 27) have no named analyst and are excluded. The Nov 10 BofA Buy reiteration has no target in the source.
